title: Fix Flaky Process 3D Attach Volume Kernel Test
description: Investigate and fix the flaky process3d engine test tests::attach_increases_volume_above_stock. Determine whether the process-wide shared ProcessKernelSession memo cache reuses geometry across tests because its replay key is insufficiently isolated, or whether BrepkitKernel fuse has a real near-boundary precision bug. Implement the root fix with regression coverage and confirm cargo test -p semio-s-app-process-3d-engine --lib succeeds at least 10 consecutive times.
summary: Investigated the flaky process3d attach-volume test and disproved the shared memo collision hypothesis: failing runs used the correct fresh stock and attach handles, while repeated volume reads of the same near-boundary fused solid varied at the B-rep measurement deflection of 0.1. Tightened public B-rep volume measurement deflection to 0.01 while leaving the internal boolean probe at 0.1 to avoid CSG performance regressions. Isolated every process replay-volume test with its own ProcessKernelSession and strengthened attach_increases_volume_above_stock to cover 32 fresh kernel sessions. Verification: focused attach regression passed 10 consecutive runs, B-rep volume subset passed 4 of 4, and cargo test -p semio-s-app-process-3d-engine --lib passed 10 consecutive full-suite runs with 14 of 14 tests each.
